# Catalystory

> Catalystory is a film production company and story consultancy based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Los Angeles, California. It produces and directs character-driven films, short films and music videos, takes on commissioned directing and producing work, and offers script notes, series bible review and story coaching for screenwriters. Founded by writer-director J. Penberth Rabold and producer Shannon Geary.

Website: https://catalystory.com
Contact: info@catalystory.com

## Story consulting
- [Story consulting overview](https://catalystory.com/story-consulting)
- [Script notes](https://catalystory.com/story-consulting/script-notes) (developmental notes on plot, structure, character and theme; not script coverage)
- [Series bible review](https://catalystory.com/story-consulting/series-bible-review)
- [Story coaching and outline sessions](https://catalystory.com/story-consulting/story-coaching) (one-on-one over Zoom)

## About
- [About Catalystory](https://catalystory.com/about)
- J. Penberth Rabold: writer and director; fifteen years as a unit production manager and first assistant director; series bibles, pilots and features that have reached Netflix, Apple, Starz and HBO; director of the short film Connected. https://jpenberth.com
- Shannon Geary: producer; 21 years as a music educator and theater director; mentored by the late Stephen Emery.
- Current film: Dallas & Allegra, a Rust Belt romance short film shot in Pittsburgh. https://dallasandallegra.com
